call_overview.question: What does the call offer, and who can apply?

cards.title: What the call wants
cards.question: What is the principal thing the project must develop, and which problem or need must it address?
cards.answer:
Research into new materials for large-scale energy storage and conversion, together with new, scalable ways to produce them.
NWO (the Dutch Research Council) is still preparing this call; only a short description has been published. The materials should match the time scales the energy transition needs (hours, days or weeks) and multi-commodity forms (storing or converting energy across electricity, heat, gases or fuels). Ideally they can be applied close to the energy source: in or near generation systems, electrical infrastructure and the process industry, or in buildings such as homes and offices. The research must look beyond material properties: the production process, including transport and storage logistics, must also be developed. Existing large-scale developments such as hydrogen are excluded. The need is framed as one of the energy transition as a whole; the call text that will say whose problem must justify a proposal has not yet been published.
cards.sources:
NWO call page, New materials and production processes for large-scale energy storage and conversion · introduction and Disclaimer
NWO call page (Dutch), Nieuwe materialen en maakprocessen voor grootschalige energieopslag en conversie · introduction

cards.title: Innovation
cards.question: How new must the project be, and in what must it innovate?
cards.answer:
The call asks for genuinely new materials and new production processes, not the application of existing ones.
The innovation covers both the material itself and its manufacturing route, including transport and storage logistics, so that the materials can be produced at scale. Hydrogen, as an existing large-scale development, is excluded.

call_overview.title: Relevance to TenneT
call_overview.question: Why is this call relevant to TenneT?

cards.title: Why it matters to TenneT
cards.question: Why does this call matter to TenneT, and why can't TenneT take part itself?
cards.answer:
Large-scale storage placed near generation and electrical infrastructure is a future source of flexibility that could ease grid congestion and support balancing.
TenneT already uses storage as a grid resource, for example through the time-dependent transmission rights contract with battery operator Lion Storage in Zeeland, and works on flexibility in projects such as Grids & Benefits. New storage materials that last hours to weeks and can be produced cheaply at scale could widen the options available to storage operators connected to TenneT's grid. Interpretation: the call is materials science led by researchers, so its benefit to TenneT is indirect and long term, through knowledge and future storage products. TenneT cannot be shown to have a role: the call is still in preparation and NWO has not yet published the rules on who may apply or take part.
cards.sources: Interpretation based on: NWO call page, New materials and production processes for large-scale energy storage and conversion · introduction and Disclaimer

funding_timing_submission.title: Funding
funding_timing_submission.question: How much funding can the project receive?

cards.title: Funding envelope
cards.answer:
NWO plans an indicative total budget of EUR 7 million for the call; the amount per project is not yet published.
- Grant request: not yet published; the EUR 7,000,000 is the total for the whole call
- Funding form: not yet published
NWO states that the budget and dates of calls in preparation may still change, and that the final call text decides.
cards.sources: NWO call page, New materials and production processes for large-scale energy storage and conversion · Characteristics, Budget; Disclaimer

funding_timing_submission.title: Timing
funding_timing_submission.question: What timing should the proposal submission and project follow?

cards.title: Application route
cards.answer:
One indicative deadline is known: full applications by 14 May 2027, 14:00, subject to change.
- Stage 1 — Full proposal: 14 May 2027, 14:00 (indicative)
NWO publishes the final call text, with the application procedure, on the call page and in the Staatscourant (the Dutch government gazette) once its Executive Board approves the call.
